scope: Visual inspection of the anonymous live waiting-update, updated and cold-offline screenshots from the root agent's completed probe.

screenshots.review: The previous release remains visible while the new worker waits. Update App is prominent and the full draft-saving-before-reload message is readable. Existing sign-in controls and installation guidance remain intact with no horizontal overlap.

The new dark-mode sign-in page is visibly more compact: language/theme controls are quiet, Email/Password and Sign in are clear, and Forgot password, sign-in help and phone installation are collapsed but discoverable. QR guide remains visible. The complete sign-in card fits the initial phone viewport without overlap.

The updated sign-in layout remains intact after a cold-offline launch. The red Offline - submissions will wait cue is visible above the sign-in card; controls and expandable help remain readable without missing assets or overlap.

limits: Anonymous Chromium evidence only; does not certify physical-phone updates or preservation of an authenticated live draft.
